topic: Cold and flu myths vs facts
headline: Cold and flu
subhead: Swipe to test what you know.
intro: Cold season brings lots of advice. Here's what's true, and when to ask your pharmacist.

points.title: Myth: Cold air = a cold
points.body: Fact: Colds come from viruses. They spread more in winter because we spend more time indoors.

points.title: Antibiotics for colds?
points.body: Fact: Antibiotics don't work on viruses like colds and flu. Ask us about symptom relief.

points.title: Myth: More is better
points.body: Fact: Two cold products can double up an ingredient. Read the label and ask us first.

cta_body: Our pharmacists are happy to help you choose.
